questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① perform(수행하다) — selective(선택적인) — proposed(제안된): 모두 원문 일치 ← 정답
❌ ② avoid(피하다): perform(수행하다)의 반의어
❌ ③ mandatory(의무적인): selective(선택적인)의 반의어
❌ ④ canceled(취소된): proposed(제안된)와 문맥 불일치
det.tip: contractors will perform, selective gas service, proposed road improvements

❌ ① distributed(배포된): attached(첨부된)와 문맥 불일치

questions.passage: Dear Homeowner / Resident: Beginning around mid-April, 2017, contractors for the City of Southfield will perform water main and pavement replacement in your area. Consumers Energy will also perform __________ as part of the work. A map is attached to this letter which shows areas of water main replacement and road replacement. The proposed road improvements are made possible thanks to the City's $99 million Street Improvements Bond which was approved by voters in 2016. The water main will be replaced under the water fund. Work is scheduled to begin during April 2017. The majority of work will be completed by November 15, 2017. Some minor restoration of lawn areas that is not completed in the 2017 growing season will be completed in early spring of 2018.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: selective gas service renewal(선택적 가스 서비스 갱신) — Consumers Energy가 공사의 일환으로 일부 가스 서비스를 교체하는 작업. 수도관·도로 교체와 구분.
det.analysis:
❌ ① water main replacement — 수도관 공사는 city contractors가 담당
✅ ② selective gas service renewal ← 정답 (Consumers Energy 담당)
❌ ③ road replacement — 도로 교체는 city contractors가 담당
❌ ④ lawn restoration — 잔디 복원은 공사 후 마무리 작업
det.tip: Consumers Energy will also perform selective gas service renewal as part of the work

questions.passage: Dear Homeowner / Resident: Beginning around mid-April, 2017, contractors for the City of Southfield will perform water main and pavement replacement in your area. Consumers Energy will also perform selective gas service renewal as part of the work. A map is attached to this letter which shows areas of water main replacement and road replacement. The proposed road improvements are made possible thanks to the City's $99 million Street Improvements Bond which was approved by voters in 2016. The water main will be replaced under the water fund. Work is scheduled to begin during April 2017. The majority of work will be completed by November 15, 2017. Some minor restoration of lawn areas that is not completed in the 2017 growing season will be completed in __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: early spring of 2018(2018년 이른 봄) — 2017년 성장 시즌에 완료되지 않은 잔여 잔디 복원 작업이 이듬해 초봄에 완료될 예정
det.analysis:
❌ ① November 15, 2017 — 대부분의 작업 완료 시점 (잔여 잔디 복원 아님)
❌ ② the 2017 growing season — 이 시즌 내 미완료 잔여분에 대한 시점
✅ ③ early spring of 2018 ← 정답
❌ ④ mid-April, 2017 — 공사 시작 시점
det.tip: not completed in the 2017 growing season will be completed in early spring of 2018
